construction_secondary.role: Construction PPE, machinery and vehicle detection

excluded_models.models/candidates/prodbykosta_person_yol: Excluded from the final ensemble after a real project sample was classified as horse instead of person.

safety_rules.helmet_safe: Require overlapping Helmet/Hardhat confirmation from BOTH selected models and temporal confirmation in at least 3 of 5 frames.
safety_rules.vest_safe: Require overlapping Vest/Safety Vest confirmation from BOTH selected models and temporal confirmation in at least 3 of 5 frames.
safety_rules.ppe_disagreement: Do not mark worker SAFE. Store status as PPE_NOT_CONFIRMED and continue temporal evaluation.
safety_rules.machinery: Use construction_secondary machinery/vehicle detections as equipment candidates, then track equipment and create a dynamic danger zone.
safety_rules.missing_ppe: Never infer missing PPE from a single absent detection. Use tracked person + temporal evidence + explicit negative class when available.
